banner.label: Manufacturing
description: SWe manufacture PET strapping for industrial packaging, load securing, product bundling, and transportation applications. Our production processes are designed to maintain consistent product dimensions, strength, and performance across different PET strap specifications.
From raw material processing to finished roll packaging, each stage is carried out according to defined production and quality requirements.

whoWeAre.label: PET strap manufacturing facility

headingParts.text: A production setup focused on repeatable PET strap quality.

description: Our facility produces PET strapping in different specifications for varied industrial packaging applications. Controlled production stages support consistent product dimensions, strength, surface and roll formation.
Quality inspection is integrated into manufacturing, while production planning supports reliable supply for domestic and international orders.

technicalPerformance.label: Our PET strap manufacturing process

headingParts.text: Eight controlled stages from preparation to dispatch.

technicalPerformance.description: The manufacturing flow is organized to form, stabilize, inspect, wind and package PET strap according to defined product requirements.

list.title: Raw Material Preparation
list.description: PET material is prepared for controlled processing and production.

list.title: Extrusion
list.description: Prepared material is processed through extrusion to form the strap profile.

list.title: Stretching & Orientation
list.description: The strap is stretched and oriented to develop the required product characteristics.

list.title: Embossing
list.description: The strap surface is formed according to the required smooth or embossed finish.

list.title: Cooling & Stabilization
list.description: The strap is cooled and stabilized as it moves through the production line.

list.title: Quality Testing
list.description: Dimensions, strength and visible product condition are reviewed during production.

list.title: Winding
list.description: Finished strap is wound into rolls with attention to roll formation and handling.

list.title: Packaging & Dispatch
list.description: Approved rolls are packed as required and prepared for dispatch.

manufactureProcess.label: Quality control at every stage

headingParts.text: Inspection points throughout the production flow.

manufactureProcess.description: Quality control begins before production and continues through dimensional, strength, surface and final product review.

list.title: Raw Material Inspection
list.description: Incoming material is reviewed before production processing.

list.title: In-Process Inspection
list.description: Production conditions and strap formation are monitored during manufacturing.

list.title: Dimensional Checks
list.description: Width, thickness and related dimensions are checked against the requirement.

list.title: Strength Testing
list.description: Strap strength is reviewed against the defined product specification.

list.title: Surface & Appearance Inspection
list.description: Surface, color, roll formation and visible condition are inspected.

list.title: Final Product Approval
list.description: Finished rolls are reviewed before packaging and dispatch.

floatingCardTwo.description: Checks are integrated through production, not left to the final stage.
